description: Illustrative heritage settings, generated working concepts for human art review. Mexico supplies the style reference for the other landscapes.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: working background illustration for Relic Revival Run, a warm hand-inked 2D side-scrolling game about animal art conservators restoring cultural heritage. Primary request: a beautiful horizontally wide Mexican heritage landscape, gentle cream-paper grain, soft gouache washes, confident warm brown ink contours, muted jade jungle hills and a respectfully depicted distant Maya stepped stone temple, terracotta and golden late-afternoon light. Composition: landscape 16:9, side-view game backdrop, generous pale apricot sky in the upper half for interface readability; temple in middle distance to the right, layered low foliage and stone terraces near bottom, continuous level horizontal ground at 86 percent of image height, foreground warm terracotta earth. Detailed architecture but restrained contrast so small characters and gameplay targets remain legible. Cozy illustrated travel-journal feel, not photorealistic, no characters, no text, no logos, no flags, no UI. This is a placeholder art direction concept for later human redraw.
